headline: E2E Networks Limited launches Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP) with floor price of ₹2,630.60 per share
sum: E2E Networks' Fund Raise Committee approves QIP issue opening and sets floor price at ₹2,630.60/share under SEBI ICDR Regulations. The placement mechanism allows qualified institutional investors to subscribe to new equity at a regulated minimum price, with preliminary placement document adopted same day.
implication: QIP floor price derivation under SEBI ICDR formula establishes the regulatory price-protection baseline; counsel must verify the 90-day lookback computation and manage pricing-related conditions precedent and lock-in periods post-allotment.
detail: E2E Networks, a technology infrastructure company, initiated a Qualified Institutions Placement on 25 February 2026 via Board-level Fund Raise Committee approval. The floor price of ₹2,630.60 per equity share was determined in accordance with the SEBI ICDR Regulations 2018 pricing formula (typically a 90-day volume-weighted average price adjustment mechanism). The Preliminary Placement Document (PPD) dated 26 February 2026 was adopted the same day, incorporating the application form and terms of issue. The QIP allows E2E Networks to raise capital from qualified institutional buyers including FIIs, AIFs, mutual funds and insurance companies, subject to regulatory compliance and stock exchange approval.
